About Baddi University 
Baddi University is the best university in Himachal Pradesh approved by the UGC, PCI India has been named among the top-ranking universities in Himachal Pradesh. The Baddi University common entrance Test has various scopes since it provides a chance of forming a well-built educational foundation in the present competitive market. The main purpose of conducting BU-CET is to judge the student’s ability, sharpness, knowledge, etc. Baddi University offers academic scholarships to qualified students willing to choose Baddi University for the up-gradation of their academic careers.

Placements Overview 
Almost from the last two decades, Baddi University had a path-breaking recruitment record for all the graduates and post-graduate students from different academic programs. We offer an industry-oriented environment which sessions for their career planning right from the beginning of their studies. Baddi University has joined hands with the native industries to help students belonging to weaker sections under academic adoption, “Earn while you learn”. We are also helping students to convert their ideas into business and those who are seeking higher studies.
